dog.description_text: Meet Zag — New Arrival! Zag just arrived and is still getting settled in, so we’re just beginning to learn who they are. Right now, everything is new—new people, new sounds, new routines—and we’re giving them time to relax, decompress, and show us their true personality at their own pace. Here’s what we know so far about his time in foster care: https://bestfriends.sharepoint.com/:b:/r/sites/GRP_NYC_Foster/Shared%20Documents/Forms/AllItems.aspx?id=%2Fsites%2FGRP%5FNYC%5FFoster%2FShared%20Documents%2FGeneral%2FZag%20%2D%20About%20Me%2Epdf&parent=%2Fsites%2FGRP%5FNYC%5FFoster%2FShared%20Documents%2FGeneral&p=true&share=cQpbm16kyAfPTbMwdfpvJmqMEgUCEdszrvBZvIDywJC8vZm4vQ This handsome boy is a total lovebug. His foster says "Is shy for an hour and then he is ready to cuddle and be near you. becomes super bonded to people he lives with. He has so much love and is super go with the flow. You can pet him everywhere and he just wants to cuddle. He likes to put his face in your face and nuzzle into your face and neck.". He is very social and loving. He is neutered , vaccinated, microchipped, and has had preventative treatments to ensure he is ready for his next steps. Submit an adoption survey from above and our team will reach out via phone or email (check spam) to schedule a counseling call. Please remember, pets cannot be held or reserved.
